einzeiler: Surrogacy scandal couple arrested on child abuse charges following police surveillance.
kurzfassung: Months after initial investigations, Los Angeles authorities arrested Sylvia Zhang and Guojun Xuan on multiple felony charges, including child abuse and conspiracy. During their arraignment, prosecutors revealed the couple controlled numerous bank accounts moving quarter-billion-dollar sums and possessed multiple passports. Meanwhile, federal investigators are examining Guojun's financial activities and his connections to prominent political figures linked to Chinese influence operations.
stichpunkte: Los Angeles District Attorney Nathan Hockman announced serious felony charges against Sylvia Zhang and Guojun Xuan for child abuse.
Surveillance footage from the couple's mansion captured nannies and Guojun physically striking the children.
Prosecutors requested a $100 million bail citing a quarter-billion dollars moved across roughly 200 bank accounts and multiple passports.
The judge ultimately set bail at $20 million per defendant with strict non-financial conditions including surrender of passports and electronic monitoring.
Defense attorney Mitchell Krems argued the couple was targeted unfairly due to their Chinese immigrant background and denied any child abuse or CCP ties.
Federal authorities are investigating Guojun's business dealings, potential money laundering, and associations with figures tied to Chinese influence operations like former Arcadia mayor Aileen Wang.
Surrogates who carried children for the couple expressed frustration that authorities did not intervene sooner to prevent years of abuse.

clips.hook: Motion-activated cameras captured nannies striking children
clips.text: Over thirty motion-activated security cameras installed throughout the residence recorded nannies physically hitting and slapping the young children.

clips.hook: A quarter of a billion dollars moved between accounts
clips.text: Financial records showed that approximately $250 million had been transferred across roughly two hundred bank accounts controlled by the couple.

clips.hook: Defense attorney claims unfair treatment due to background
clips.text: The defense counsel asserted that his clients faced extreme scrutiny solely because they are Chinese immigrants from a communist country.

clips.hook: Arcadia mayor steps down after pleading guilty
clips.text: A news broadcast excerpt reports that the mayor of Arcadia resigned immediately after pleading guilty to acting as an agent for China.

clips.hook: Surrogate expresses frustration over ignored warnings
clips.text: A surrogate mother voiced deep anger that clinics, lawyers, and others repeatedly ignored red flags because they were being paid by the couple.

beschreibung:
Three weeks after we released “The Journey,” Guojun Xuan and Silvia Zhang were arrested, and local prosecutors charged them in a child-abuse case. The F.B.I. is now looking into the couple, and new details have emerged about what happened inside their mansion.
